message.content:
This editorial illustration shows a light-skinned man wearing a black academic gown with an orange stole and a black mortarboard cap with a yellow band and tassel. He faces left, wearing wire-rimmed glasses. His lower body and the back of his gown are transforming into numerous black and white rectangular shapes that float behind him. These shapes further transform into dozens of small mobile phones, specifically models with physical keyboards and screens, which scatter across the right side of the frame. Some phone shapes are faint or semi-transparent.

The background is plain white with a vertical red band on the far left. Large black text reads "TEMPO" across the top. Above it, smaller text says "TOKOH SENI 2012" and "BMW MAUT ANAK MENTERI." Below the logo, "EDISI 7-13 JANUARI 2013" is visible. At the bottom right, large red text reads "PING!!!" above the black text "VONIS MIRING" and a three-line block of smaller black text starting with "Hakim agung ditengarai." The bottom left features price information, a website, and a barcode.
